faqItems.question: How can automation by LeTRON help my business?
faqItems.answer: The LeOS platform digitizes your entire operating workflow, collecting and analyzing data in real time to optimize costs, boost efficiency, and reduce errors from manual processes.

faqItems.question: Is it difficult to integrate LeTRON AI into my current system?
faqItems.answer: LeOS is built to integrate flexibly with your existing infrastructure and software through open APIs. LeTRON's technical team works alongside you throughout deployment to ensure a smooth transition.

faqItems.question: Which industries can benefit from AI-driven automation?
faqItems.answer: LeTRON's solutions apply to a wide range of industries — energy, construction materials, smart cities, and mobility — any field that needs data-driven operations can benefit.

faqItems.question: How long does it take to set up LeTRON?
faqItems.answer: Setup time depends on the scale and complexity of your existing systems. A pilot project can typically go live within just a few weeks, working alongside LeTRON's technical team.

faqItems.question: Can I request a customized LeTRON solution?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Beyond our existing products, LeTRON offers consulting and custom solution development tailored to each business's specific operations.

principles.title: Data with a clear origin
principles.body: Every figure comes with its source, time and collection conditions, so you decide on data you can trust.

principles.title: Autonomy within limits people set
principles.body: You define what machines may do, how far, and when a person must step in. The system never exceeds that scope.

principles.title: Every result has an owner
principles.body: Each task is tied to who assigned it, who did it and the acceptance evidence. No result is ownerless.

factory.title:

factory.body: LeASO assigns the work, Le-NodeFactory collects data at the machine, Le-ORION performs the repetitive steps. Every shift ends with results checked and recorded, with no manual reconciliation.

loop.title: One task. Five steps. One record.
loop.lead: Every job, whether done by people or machines, goes through the same five steps. So you always know where the work is, who owns it and whether the result is in.

stages.name: Assign
stages.body: Define the work, the owner, the scope and the completion criteria.

stages.name: Execute
stages.body: Devices and robots work within the assigned scope. Anything unusual is logged immediately.

stages.name: Check
stages.body: Actual results are compared with the agreed criteria. No evidence, not yet passed.

stages.name: Keep evidence
stages.body: The record is tied to the task, the configuration and the check result, ready for audit and acceptance.

stages.name: Maintain
stages.body: Equipment condition data turns into inspection and repair work before a failure happens.

loop.stampNote: Illustrative process diagram; the connection to your systems is set up during the pilot.

items.title: Understand the real problem

items.title: Scale once it passes
